description: Paired-seed sensitivity assay on the declared Diamond Princess replay at the v11 admissible-band centre. THETA-SCREEN-V11-S2 measured takeoff seeds recording ~3,470-3,520 onsets against the record's 197 (~17.7x), with attack ~0.95 against the record's ~712/3,711. This assay asks which model machinery could account for that gap: it holds Theta fixed at the band centre and removes or strengthens one suppression channel per arm, scoring the conditional-on-takeoff recorded-onset mass against the record's neighbourhood on the same 20 seeds as stage 2.
prerequisites: THETA-SCREEN-V11-S2 (8cda4c7 / 9ba9d5e): the measured stage-2 surface this assay interrogates. Theta-insensitivity of conditional outbreak size (~1% median range across the band) is what licenses a single-Theta assay.

QUAR-ATTR-V2 (d62f10d): the during-quarantine channel attributions at v9-lattice Theta {1e5, 1e9} -- crew confinement -74%, pool transport -66% of the during-window conditional median, A5 collapses takeoff. The assay re-measures those channels at the band-centre Theta where the bulk of the onset mass accrues.
QUAR-ORDER-01, DOSE-FRAIL-01, INDEX-GEOM-01, SEED-ONSET-01: unchanged replay machinery.
The arm-override grammar of covid_boarding_screen.py extended by this change set: config_overrides, scheduled_protocol_window, infection_counters, transmission_overrides.
thetas_note: Single value, the admissible-band centre, and it is NOT an axis: stage 2 measured conditional recorded-onset medians moving ~1% across 2.37e10-7.5e10, so Theta carries no information about conditional size inside the band. 4.22e10 is the band's geometric centre; nothing else about the band edge is being asked here.
infection_age_note: Single value, not an axis -- cancels exactly under the declared onset_day (QUAR-ATTR-V1, THETA-SCREEN-V9).
seeds_note: The SAME 20 seeds as stage 2 and the v9/v11 lineage, so every arm is a paired-seed read against A0 at the same Theta: the A0 row re-runs as the execution witness and must reproduce the stage-2 Theta 4.22e10 row's statistics within Monte Carlo noise (the cells are identical machinery; a systematic mismatch is a wiring defect in the arm path, not a finding).
cells_note: 12 arms x 20 seeds at a single Theta. The age and import axes are single-valued. Cost ~ equal to the QUAR-ATTR-V2 array.

gap_decomposition.statement: The 17.7x recorded-onset gap decomposes as ~4.7x biological over-burn (takeoff-seed infections_total ~3,250-3,550 and attack ~0.95 vs the record's ~712 cases / 0.19 attack) compounded with ~3.5x observational bookkeeping (the record's 197 dated onsets are ~28-31% of its 634 confirmed positives -- covid.T3 -- while the model's recorded_onsets channel reports every symptomatic onset that a post-day-14 specimen confirms). A transmission-layer lever that produced the true ~712-case burn would still overcount recorded_onsets roughly 3.5x unless the observation channel is also implicated. The assay therefore scores BOTH reads per arm: infections_total against ~712, and recorded_onsets against 197.
gap_decomposition.note: Decomposed from the stage-2 surface and covid.T1/T3 target definitions; no arm is allowed to claim the record by moving only the observational share.

arms.role: baseline, and the only arm that is the declared Diamond Princess replay
arms.note: Shipped defaults. Execution witness: must reproduce the stage-2 Theta 4.22e10 row's takeoff fraction and conditional recorded-onset statistics within seed-identical equivalence (same seeds, same spec); a mismatch invalidates the run rather than becoming a finding.

arms.role: counterfactual: removes the crew channel during quarantine
arms.note: Verbatim from covid_quarantine_attribution_v1: SOP-017-ALLHANDS is historically FALSE (crew kept working essential service) and may never score an anchor. Re-measured at band Theta because QUAR-ATTR-V2 read it at Theta 1e9 on a mostly post-quarantine mass; at 4.22e10 the dominant mass accrues earlier and the channel's reach may differ.
Verbatim from covid_quarantine_attribution_v1: no pathogen's airborne pool crosses a zone. Measures the airflow network's contribution at band Theta.

arms.role: counterfactual: removes the near-field / per-meal table channel
arms.note: Verbatim from covid_quarantine_attribution_v1. Non-load-bearing at Theta 1e9 (+19%); re-measured here because the arm set is cheap and a different Theta regime could change which mess channel matters.

arms.role: counterfactual: both during-quarantine structural channels removed
arms.note: Verbatim from covid_quarantine_attribution_v1: channel contributions are not additive in a saturating epidemic.

arms.role: counterfactual: every shared-air dose term removed, leaving contact and fomite
arms.note: Verbatim from covid_quarantine_attribution_v1: physically false for SARS-CoV-2, never an anchor candidate; collapsed takeoff at Theta 1e9 (1/20). At 4.22e10 it probes whether a contact+fomite-only ship can still burn -- if yes, the shared-air terms are not the load-bearing layer for the mass.

arms.role: sensitivity: halves the direct-contact route's delivered dose
arms.note: route_efficiency_multipliers are independent per-route dose multipliers (not shares). This is a DOSE-side probe, deliberately partially degenerate with Theta on the contact route: the read is how much of the conditional mass rides the contact channel. If halving contact dose barely moves the medians, contact is not the carrier of the over-burn.

arms.role: sensitivity: quarters the direct-contact route's delivered dose
arms.note: As A6 at a deeper cut; together A6/A7 give a two-point dose-response on the contact route rather than a single flag.

arms.role: counterfactual: the cabin-quarantine order issues four days earlier
arms.note: DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL, historically false: MHLW ordered confinement for 5 February (day 16). Day 12 is 1 February -- the date the index case's Hong Kong result became public and the first date a confinement order could have been informed by it. Measures calendar sensitivity: how much of the conditional mass was already committed before any quarantine could bind. Never an anchor candidate.

arms.role: counterfactual bound: confined passengers transmit nothing
arms.note: DIAGNOSTIC BOUND, not a proposed configuration: the shipped confinement_isolation_factor is 0.05 (platform value). Setting it to zero removes the residual confined-transmission channel entirely (cabin-corridor contact and emission terms scale to nil for confined agents), giving the upper bound on what a stronger lockdown could have done. If even this bound leaves the conditional mass far above the record, confinement strength is not the missing mechanism.

arms.role: counterfactual bound: symptomatic agents confined from the first reported case
arms.note: DIAGNOSTIC COUNTERFACTUAL: the shipped VSP rule confines all symptomatic agents once reported passenger cases reach 3% (~80 passengers); the counter fires mid-window at best. Threshold 0.0004 ~= 1/2666 confines symptomatic agents from the FIRST reported sick call, the strongest possible reactive-symptomatic channel in this machinery. The counter list is crusher_labs/config.yaml's infection_counters verbatim with only passenger_reported_case_rate.threshold changed; wholesale list replacement is the override's declared semantics. Never an anchor candidate; measures the marginal reach of a perfect reactive response.

arms.role: counterfactual floor probe: every plausible suppression channel at once
arms.note: Declared because single-lever reads under-determine the floor: if NO single arm approaches the record, this arm tests whether ANY combination of the assayed levers can -- and if it cannot, the ~18x gap is not reachable inside the transmission layer at all and points at the observational channel or natural history. A takeoff collapse here is itself the informative outcome (the floor is unreachable without killing the outbreak).

cell_payload_additions.arm_id: The arm this cell was run under, echoed for audit.
cell_payload_additions.note: Stage-2 payload fields retained verbatim so the two surfaces read the same way: recorded_onsets, onsets_before/on_or_after_split_day, campaign_positives, asymptomatic_share, index_onset_day, index_shedding_at_day0, attack_rate, infections_total, aboard_total.

scoring.statement: FROZEN before any assay cell exists. Per arm, on the seeds that took off in BOTH the arm and A0 (recorded_onsets >= 10 under each): (i) median recorded_onsets of the arm and the ratio to A0's paired median; (ii) the arm's q05-q95 recorded_onsets interval and whether it contains 197; (iii) the fraction of the arm's takeoff seeds with recorded_onsets in the near-target band [98.5, 394]; (iv) median infections_total against the record's ~712; (v) median before_share against 0.173; (vi) the arm's own takeoff count -- an arm that suppresses takeoff below 5 seeds is reported 'insufficient takeoff mass' for the conditional read and its all-seed median is still quoted.

verdict_bands.closes_the_gap: conditional recorded_onsets q05-q95 contains 197 AND the conditional median lies in [98.5, 394]
verdict_bands.load_bearing: conditional recorded_onsets median falls by >= 50% vs A0
verdict_bands.takeoff_collapse: arm takeoff < 5/20 -- the suppression bound kills the outbreak rather than resizing it

scoring.note: No arm may be quoted as a fitted configuration: counterfactual arms are physically or historically false by declaration. The deliverable is a mechanism map, not a refit -- an arm that 'closes_the_gap' names WHERE the over-burn lives; whether that suppression is real-world justified is a provenance question for the next session, per .agents/skills/model-parameter-provenance.

what_this_cannot_settle: It cannot re-run the fleet-shape selector: arms that suppress transmission would also shift the generic 7-day surface, and re-checking covid.H3 admissibility under a suppressed configuration is a downstream question this design deliberately does not touch.
It cannot adjudicate the observational share of the gap (the 28-31% dated-onset bookkeeping); it only reports recorded_onsets beside infections_total so the decomposition stays visible.

It cannot test natural-history or susceptibility-distribution levers (infectious period, frailty spread): pathogen_overrides is not an arm axis, and DOSE-FRAIL-01's frailty draw is not seed-pairable across parameter moves. Those channels are named here as the remaining suspect class if every transmission-layer arm fails.
It cannot produce a fitted Theta, and no Theta on this surface may be quoted as one.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot, per .agents/skills/aws-batch-campaign/SKILL.md, via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_sensitivity_assay_v1. The image must be built from a main that contains this design file: the design is read inside the container. Job definition revision and image digest pinned per campaign-preflight step 3, never a bare tag.
execution.canary: Two canary rows because the assay extends the arm grammar (enumeration is axis-point x arm x seed, so at one Theta A0 occupies indices 0-19 and A11 occupies 220-239): (a) array of 20 at INDEX_OFFSET 0 -- the A0_declared row, inspected as the execution witness against the stage-2 Theta 4.22e10 row's statistics; (b) array of 20 at INDEX_OFFSET 220 -- the A11_arrest_bound row, inspected to prove every new override key reaches the engine: its payload must differ from A0's on the same seeds and a spec dump must show the scheduled window at day 12, confinement factor 0.0, and the replaced counter list. Preflight additionally requires the local smoke to exercise apply_arm_overrides on every arm, proving no override is silently ignored.
report_immediately_if: any arm's conditional q05-q95 contains 197 (the record is reachable at all)
A11_arrest_bound still over-produces by more than ~4x -- meaning the transmission layer cannot account for the gap and the deficit lives in the observational channel or natural history
the A0 witness row's statistics do not reproduce the stage-2 Theta 4.22e10 row
